name: Adelaide University
description: Adelaide University is a public university in Adelaide formed by merging the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia. It began teaching under its new name in 2026.
whyIncluded: Adelaide University is among the 10 universities in Australia most chosen by international students (7,350 new overseas student commencements allocated for 2026 by the Australian Department of Education), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Adelaide University's own guide to student living costs in Adelaide (rent, utilities, groceries, transport, phone, personal items, clothing and study materials), using the middle of its ranges.
livingCosts.notes: Adelaide University FAQ 'What is the cost of living in Adelaide?' (no year given; 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints converted to monthly (weekly x 52/12): accommodation AUD$150-$600+ per week (375/wk = 1,625) + utilities (private rental) $150-$300 per month (225) = housing 1,850; groceries $60-$200 a week (130/wk = 563.33); public transport 28-day pass $27.80 (x 13/12 = 30.12); personal = mobile phone $25-$110 a month (67.50) + personal care $25-$70 a month (47.50) + clothing $50-$100 a month (75) + study materials $500-$1,500 a year (83.33) = 273.33. Excluded: dining out ($15-$30 a meal), car ownership ($50-$100 a week), OSHC ($580-$4,000 a year). The accommodation range is open-ended ('$600+').
